title: I Test a Lot of Pet Tech. These Discounted Automatic Litter Boxes Are Worth Buying Now
gist: An affiliate deals post highlights pre-Black Friday discounts of up to $100 on Petkit automatic litter boxes, feeders and fountains at Shop.com and Amazon, with the reviewer naming the Purobot Max Pro 2 her best overall pick.

themes.theme: Petkit pricing and early holiday discounts

insights.claim: Petkit automatic litter boxes rarely go on significant sale before the holidays, but several models were discounted by up to $100 at Shop.com in late October, comparable to typical Black Friday discounts.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Holiday discounting is being pulled forward into October in consumer pet tech.
insights.quote: They rarely goes on significant sale until the holidays

insights.claim: The Petkit Purobot Max Pro 2 was discounted from $600 to $500 and the camera-equipped Purobot Ultra from $900 to $800.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Premium smart litter boxes carry $400-$900 price points, indicating a high-ASP pet tech niche.

insights.claim: Premium pet devices now bundle AI cameras with multi-cat facial recognition, usage tracking and health-trend monitoring via connected apps, as in the Purobot Max Pro 2 and YumShare Dual-Hopper 2 feeder.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Computer vision and app subscriptions are spreading into pet care hardware.

insights.claim: The reviewer, having tested over two dozen automatic litter boxes, says her top pick is almost always a Petkit model.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Petkit holds a leading reviewer mindshare position in automatic litter boxes.
insights.quote: I’ve tested over two dozen automatic cat litter box models, and my top pick is almost always a model from pet tech brand Petkit.
